hooks.name: Auto-test the skeleton
hooks.description: When any file in packages/skeleton/src is saved, run npm test. If any test fails, explain which test failed and why, and suggest a fix.

action.prompt:
A file in packages/skeleton/src was just saved. Run `npm test` from the project root (d:\hackthhon\Kiro\ghost-sync). If all tests pass, say so briefly. If any tests fail, do the following:
1. Identify exactly which test(s) failed and their test names.
2. Explain WHY each test failed — describe the root cause in plain English.
3. Suggest a concrete fix for each failing test, showing the code change needed.
